retrieval_text: Page 94, section 5.10.1 of the OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual covers the Tote Initialization Procedure. The nearby text describes how to initialize totes at the sorter using the Zebra scanner and the Hospital laptop tote scanning application. The operator opens the application, selects "Sorter Destinations," scans the tote sorter stand position barcode located in the center of the rack on the top rail, and scans the tote barcode for the tote being placed in the stand. The order of scanning the position and tote barcodes does not affect the process. A successful scan pairing causes the scanner to flash green, while an unsuccessful pairing causes a yellow flash and requires rescanning. After a successful new set of scans, no further action is required and the operator can return the scanner application to Hospital Mode.
